_about: Short rules summaries, in our own words, for book references that otherwise show only their book and page (owner's choice, 2026-11-26). Keyed by kind, then name (or 'Name|book code' when two books share a name). tools/build.mjs joins each one onto its entry in data/book-references.json as 'sum'. They are summaries, not the books' text: the Compendium still sends players to the page for the full rules.

Feat.Aberrant Dragonmark: Needs: no other dragonmark. +1 Constitution. You pick a sorcerer cantrip and a 1st-level sorcerer spell, cast with Constitution. The 1st-level spell is free once per short or long rest. When you cast it that way you may roll one of your Hit Dice: an even result gives you that many temporary hit points, an odd one deals that much force damage to a random creature within 30 feet (you, if nobody else is near). The mark comes with a flaw you choose.
Feat.Actor: +1 Charisma. Advantage on Deception and Performance checks to pass as someone else. After listening for a minute you can copy a person's voice or a creature's sounds; a listener sees through it with an Insight check against your Deception.
Feat.Alert: +5 to initiative. You can't be surprised while conscious, and hidden attackers don't get advantage against you just for being unseen.
Feat.Athlete: +1 Strength or Dexterity. Getting up from prone costs only 5 feet, climbing costs no extra movement, and a 5-foot run-up is enough for a running jump.
Feat.Bountiful Luck: Needs: halfling. When an ally you can see within 30 feet rolls a natural 1 on an attack, check or save, your reaction lets them reroll (they keep the new roll). You then can't use your own Lucky trait until the end of your next turn.
Feat.Charger: When you Dash, a bonus action lets you make one melee weapon attack or shove. After moving at least 10 feet straight at the target, the attack deals +5 damage or the shove pushes up to 10 feet.
Feat.Crossbow Expert: Ignore the loading property of crossbows you're proficient with. No disadvantage on ranged attacks for having an enemy within 5 feet. After attacking with a one-handed weapon in the Attack action, a bonus action fires a loaded hand crossbow.
Feat.Crusher: +1 Strength or Constitution. Once per turn a bludgeoning hit can push the target 5 feet (up to one size larger than you). A bludgeoning critical hit gives everyone advantage to hit that target until your next turn.
Feat.Defensive Duelist: Needs: Dexterity 13. While holding a finesse weapon you're proficient with, your reaction adds your proficiency bonus to your AC against one melee attack that would hit.
Feat.Dragon Fear: Needs: dragonborn. +1 Strength, Constitution or Charisma. Spend a Breath Weapon use to roar instead: chosen creatures within 30 feet that can see or hear you make a Wisdom save (DC 8 + proficiency + Charisma) or are frightened for 1 minute, saving again whenever they take damage.
Feat.Dragon Hide: Needs: dragonborn. +1 Strength, Constitution or Charisma. Without armor your AC is 13 + Dexterity (a shield still helps). Retractable claws make your unarmed strikes deal 1d4 + Strength slashing.
Feat.Drow High Magic: Needs: drow. Detect magic at will, and levitate and dispel magic once each per long rest, all without a slot and cast with Charisma.
Feat.Dual Wielder: +1 AC while holding a separate melee weapon in each hand. Two-weapon fighting works with one-handed weapons that aren't light, and you draw or stow two weapons at once.
Feat.Dungeon Delver: Advantage on Perception and Investigation checks to find secret doors, advantage on saves against traps, and resistance to trap damage. You can search for traps at a normal travel pace.
Feat.Durable: +1 Constitution. When you roll a Hit Die to heal, you regain at least twice your Constitution modifier (minimum 2).
Feat.Dwarven Fortitude: Needs: dwarf. +1 Constitution. When you take the Dodge action you can spend a Hit Die to heal (roll + Constitution, minimum 1).
Feat.Eldritch Adept: Needs: Spellcasting or Pact Magic. Learn one warlock Eldritch Invocation; one with prerequisites needs you to be a warlock who meets them. You can swap it when you gain a level.
Feat.Elemental Adept: Needs: able to cast a spell. Pick acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder. Your spells ignore resistance to it, and 1s on its damage dice count as 2s. Can be taken again for another type.
Feat.Elven Accuracy: Needs: elf or half-elf. +1 Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma. With advantage on an attack using one of those abilities, you can reroll one of the dice once.
Feat.Ember of the Fire Giant: Needs: 4th level and Strike of the Giants (Fire). +1 Strength, Constitution or Wisdom, and fire resistance. In place of one attack, burst into flame around you (15-foot radius): chosen creatures make a Dexterity save or take 1d8 + proficiency fire and are blinded until your next turn (half damage on a save). Uses equal your proficiency bonus per long rest.
Feat.Fade Away: Needs: gnome. +1 Dexterity or Intelligence. Right after taking damage, your reaction turns you invisible until the end of your next turn or until you attack, deal damage or force a save. Once per short or long rest.
Feat.Fey Teleportation: Needs: high elf. +1 Intelligence or Charisma. You learn Sylvan, and you can cast misty step once per short or long rest without a slot (Intelligence).
Feat.Fey Touched: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma. Learn misty step and one 1st-level divination or enchantment spell. Each is free once per long rest and can also use your slots; the raised ability is your casting ability.
Feat.Fighting Initiate: Needs: proficiency with a martial weapon. Learn one fighter Fighting Style you don't already have. You can swap it whenever you'd gain an Ability Score Improvement.
Feat.Flames of Phlegethos: Needs: tiefling. +1 Intelligence or Charisma. Reroll 1s on your spells' fire damage (keeping the new roll). Casting a fire spell wreathes you in harmless flames until your next turn's end: they shed light, and anything that hits you in melee from 5 feet takes 1d4 fire.
Feat.Fury of the Frost Giant: Needs: 4th level and Strike of the Giants (Frost). +1 Strength, Constitution or Wisdom, and cold resistance. When a creature within 30 feet damages you, your reaction forces a Constitution save: on a failure it takes 1d8 + proficiency cold and its speed drops to 0 until its next turn ends. Uses equal your proficiency bonus per long rest.
Feat.Gift of the Chromatic Dragon: +1 Strength, Dexterity or Constitution. Once per long rest, a bonus action charges a weapon for 1 minute with an extra 1d4 acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison damage. When you take one of those damage types, your reaction gives you resistance to it; uses equal your proficiency bonus per long rest.
Feat.Gift of the Gem Dragon: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma. When a creature within 10 feet damages you, your reaction forces a Strength save: on a failure it takes 2d8 force and is pushed up to 10 feet. Uses equal your proficiency bonus per long rest.
Feat.Gift of the Metallic Dragon: +1 Strength, Dexterity or Intelligence. Learn cure wounds, free a number of times per long rest equal to your proficiency bonus (Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma, chosen once). When you or a creature within 5 feet is hit, your reaction adds your proficiency bonus to the target's AC against that attack; same number of uses per long rest.
Feat.Grappler: Needs: Strength 13. Advantage on attacks against a creature you're grappling. An action and another grapple check can pin it, leaving you both restrained. Creatures one size larger than you don't escape automatically.
Feat.Great Weapon Master: A melee critical hit, or dropping a creature to 0 hit points, earns a bonus-action melee attack. Before attacking with a heavy weapon you're proficient with, you may take -5 to hit for +10 damage.
Feat.Guile of the Cloud Giant: Needs: 4th level and Strike of the Giants (Cloud). +1 Strength, Constitution or Charisma. When a creature you can see hits you, your reaction gives you resistance to that attack's damage and teleports you up to 30 feet to a space you can see. Uses equal your proficiency bonus per long rest.
Feat.Gunner: +1 Dexterity. Proficiency with firearms, you ignore their loading property, and an enemy within 5 feet doesn't give your ranged attacks disadvantage.
Feat.Healer: Stabilising someone with a healer's kit also gives them 1 hit point. An action and one kit use heals a creature 1d6 + 4 + its number of Hit Dice, once per creature per short or long rest.
Feat.Heavily Armored: Needs: proficiency with medium armor. +1 Strength and proficiency with heavy armor.
Feat.Heavy Armor Master: Needs: proficiency with heavy armor. +1 Strength. In heavy armor, bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons is reduced by 3.
Feat.Infernal Constitution: Needs: tiefling. +1 Constitution. Resistance to cold and poison damage, and advantage on saves against being poisoned.
Feat.Inspiring Leader: Needs: Charisma 13. A 10-minute speech gives up to six friendly creatures within 30 feet (you included) temporary hit points equal to your level + Charisma, once per creature per short or long rest.
Feat.Keen Mind: +1 Intelligence. You always know which way is north and how many hours until sunrise or sunset, and you remember anything you saw or heard in the last month.
Feat.Keenness of the Stone Giant: Needs: 4th level and Strike of the Giants (Stone). +1 Strength, Constitution or Wisdom. Darkvision 60 feet (or 60 more). A bonus action hurls a spectral rock up to 60 feet as a ranged spell attack: 1d10 force, and a Strength save or the target falls prone. Uses equal your proficiency bonus per long rest.
Feat.Lightly Armored: +1 Strength or Dexterity and proficiency with light armor.
Feat.Linguist: +1 Intelligence. Learn three languages. You can write ciphers that others read only if taught, with magic, or with an Intelligence check against your Intelligence score + proficiency bonus.
Feat.Lucky: Three luck points per long rest. Spend one to roll an extra d20 on your attack, check or save and pick which die counts (even after rolling), or to roll a d20 against an attack on you and pick which roll the attacker uses. Opposing luck points on one roll cancel out.
Feat.Mage Slayer: When a creature within 5 feet casts a spell, your reaction makes a melee weapon attack against it. Creatures you damage have disadvantage on concentration saves. Advantage on saves against spells cast within 5 feet of you.
Feat.Magic Initiate: Pick bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock or wizard: learn two of its cantrips and one 1st-level spell. The 1st-level spell is free once per long rest at its lowest level and can also use your slots. The class sets the casting ability (Charisma, Wisdom or Intelligence).
Feat.Martial Adept: Learn two Battle Master maneuvers (save DC 8 + proficiency + Strength or Dexterity). Gain one d6 superiority die, or one more die if you already have some, back on a short or long rest.
Feat.Medium Armor Master: Needs: proficiency with medium armor. Medium armor no longer gives disadvantage on Stealth, and with Dexterity 16 or more it adds up to +3 Dexterity to your AC instead of +2.
Feat.Metamagic Adept: Needs: Spellcasting or Pact Magic. Learn two sorcerer Metamagic options and gain 2 sorcery points just for Metamagic, back on a long rest. Only one option per spell unless an option says otherwise.
Feat.Mobile: +10 feet of speed. Dashing ignores difficult terrain that turn. A creature you make a melee attack against can't make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of your turn.
Feat.Moderately Armored: Needs: proficiency with light armor. +1 Strength or Dexterity, and proficiency with medium armor and shields.
Feat.Mounted Combatant: While mounted: advantage on melee attacks against unmounted creatures smaller than your mount, you can make an attack on your mount hit you instead, and your mount takes no damage on a successful Dexterity save for half (half on a failure).
Feat.Observant: +1 Intelligence or Wisdom. You can read lips in languages you know, and your passive Perception and passive Investigation are 5 higher.
Feat.Orcish Fury: Needs: half-orc. +1 Strength or Constitution. Once per short or long rest, add one extra weapon damage die to a hit with a simple or martial weapon. Right after Relentless Endurance saves you, your reaction makes one weapon attack.
Feat.Piercer: +1 Strength or Dexterity. Once per turn, reroll one damage die of a piercing hit (keep the new roll). A piercing critical hit rolls one extra damage die.
Feat.Polearm Master: Attacking with a glaive, halberd or quarterstaff lets you make a bonus-action jab with the butt end (1d4 bludgeoning). With a glaive, halberd, pike or quarterstaff, creatures entering your reach provoke an opportunity attack.
Feat.Resilient: +1 to an ability of your choice, and proficiency in that ability's saving throws.
Feat.Revenant Blade: Needs: elf. +1 Dexterity or Strength. A double-bladed scimitar counts as finesse for you, and holding one in two hands gives +1 AC.
Feat.Ritual Caster: Needs: Intelligence or Wisdom 13. Pick a spellcasting class: you get a ritual book with two of its 1st-level ritual spells, cast only as rituals with the book in hand. You can copy more of that class's rituals you find (up to half your level, rounded up) for 2 hours and 50 gp per spell level.
Feat.Rune Shaper: Needs: Spellcasting or the Rune Carver background. Learn comprehend languages, free once per long rest. You know a few giant runes (half your proficiency bonus, rounded down), each tied to a spell. After a long rest you can inscribe a known rune on an object; while you carry it you can cast that rune's spell once without a slot.
Feat.Savage Attacker: Once per turn, reroll a melee weapon's damage dice and use either total.
Feat.Second Chance: Needs: halfling. +1 Dexterity, Constitution or Charisma. When a creature you can see hits you, your reaction makes it reroll the attack. Usable again after you roll initiative or finish a short or long rest.
Feat.Sentinel: A creature you hit with an opportunity attack stops moving for the turn. Disengaging doesn't stop your opportunity attacks. When a creature within 5 feet attacks someone else, your reaction makes a melee weapon attack against it.
Feat.Shadow Touched: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma. Learn invisibility and one 1st-level illusion or necromancy spell. Each is free once per long rest and can also use your slots; the raised ability is your casting ability.
Feat.Sharpshooter: No disadvantage at long range, and your ranged weapon attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover. Before a ranged weapon attack you're proficient with, you may take -5 to hit for +10 damage.
Feat.Shield Master: With a shield: after taking the Attack action, a bonus action shoves a creature within 5 feet. Add the shield's AC to Dexterity saves against effects that target only you. On a successful Dexterity save for half damage, your reaction lets you take none.
Feat.Skill Expert: +1 to an ability of your choice, proficiency in one skill, and expertise (double proficiency) in one skill you're proficient in.
Feat.Skilled: Proficiency in any three skills or tools.
Feat.Skulker: Needs: Dexterity 13. You can hide when only lightly obscured, missing with a ranged attack doesn't give away your hiding place, and dim light doesn't hinder your sight-based Perception.
Feat.Slasher: +1 Strength or Dexterity. Once per turn a slashing hit cuts the target's speed by 10 feet until your next turn. A slashing critical hit gives the target disadvantage on its attacks until your next turn.
Feat.Soul of the Storm Giant: Needs: 4th level and Strike of the Giants (Storm). +1 Strength, Wisdom or Charisma. A bonus action raises a 10-foot storm aura until your next turn: you resist lightning and thunder, attacks against you have disadvantage, and others starting their turn inside make a Strength save or have their speed halved. Uses equal your proficiency bonus per long rest.
Feat.Spell Sniper: Needs: able to cast a spell. Spells with attack rolls have double range and ignore half and three-quarters cover. Learn one attack cantrip from a spellcasting class's list.
Feat.Squat Nimbleness: Needs: dwarf or a Small species. +1 Strength or Dexterity, +5 feet of walking speed, proficiency in Acrobatics or Athletics, and advantage on checks to escape a grapple.
Feat.Strixhaven Initiate: Pick one of Strixhaven's five colleges. Learn two cantrips and one 1st-level spell from its list; the 1st-level spell is free once per long rest and can also use your slots. Cast them with Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma (your choice).
Feat.Strixhaven Mascot: Needs: 4th level and Strixhaven Initiate. Cast find familiar as a ritual without materials; it takes your college's mascot form. When you take the Attack action, the familiar can attack with its reaction. You can swap places with it (within 60 feet) as an action, once per long rest.
Feat.Svirfneblin Magic: Needs: deep gnome. Nondetection on yourself at will (no material component), and blindness/deafness, blur and disguise self once each per long rest, cast with Intelligence.
Feat.Tavern Brawler: +1 Strength or Constitution. Proficiency with improvised weapons, your unarmed strikes deal 1d4, and after hitting with one of those on your turn a bonus action tries to grapple.
Feat.Telekinetic: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma. Learn mage hand, cast without words or gestures, with an invisible hand (+30 feet of range if you already knew it). A bonus action shoves a creature within 30 feet 5 feet toward or away from you unless it passes a Strength save.
Feat.Telepathic: +1 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma. Speak telepathically to a creature you can see within 60 feet, in a language it knows (it can't reply this way). Detect thoughts is free once per long rest, with no components, and can also use your slots.
Feat.Tough: Your hit point maximum rises by twice your level, and by 2 more each time you level up.
Feat.Vigor of the Hill Giant: Needs: 4th level and Strike of the Giants (Hill). +1 Strength, Constitution or Wisdom. Your reaction stops an effect from moving you or knocking you prone. Eating during a short rest adds Constitution (minimum 1) + proficiency bonus to the hit points you regain from Hit Dice.
Feat.War Caster: Needs: able to cast a spell. Advantage on concentration saves, you can cast with somatic components while your hands hold weapons or a shield, and you can cast a one-action spell targeting a creature instead of making an opportunity attack against it.
Feat.Weapon Master: +1 Strength or Dexterity and proficiency with four weapons of your choice.
Feat.Wood Elf Magic: Needs: wood elf. Learn a druid cantrip, and cast longstrider and pass without trace once each per long rest without a slot, all with Wisdom.

Background.Variant Criminal (Spy): A version of the Criminal: same skills, tools, equipment and Criminal Contact feature, but you worked as a spy or informant rather than a common crook.
Background.Variant Entertainer (Gladiator): A version of the Entertainer: you perform in the arena. Your performance 'instrument' can be an inexpensive unusual weapon such as a trident or net. By Popular Demand works in arenas and fighting pits.
Background.Variant Noble (Knight): A version of the Noble for a knight of an order or a lord. You take the Retainers feature instead of Position of Privilege: one of your retainers can be a squire.
Background.Variant Noble (Retainers): A replacement for the Noble's Position of Privilege: three loyal retainers from your family's household (one of them well-born) attend you. They do everyday tasks for you but won't fight or go into obvious danger.
Background.Variant Sailor (Pirate): A version of the Sailor: you sailed as a pirate. You may take Bad Reputation instead of Ship's Passage: people fear you, so you can get away with minor crimes in town.

Monster.Adult Red Dracolich: Named in a creature table of a magic item in Tasha's (p. 137), not a full stat block of its own. Use an adult red dragon with the dracolich changes.
Monster.Booyahg Booyahg Booyahg: A goblin wild magic sorcerer from Volo's goblin lore: every spell it casts, cantrips included, sets off a wild magic surge. Built from the mage stat block with goblin darkvision and Nimble Escape.
Monster.Booyahg Caster: A goblin that picked up a little wizardry: it can cast one random 1st-level wizard spell once a day (Intelligence). Lore only, no stat block of its own.
Monster.Booyahg Slave of the Archfey: A goblin warlock of an Archfey patron: use Volo's Warlock of the Archfey stat block, adding goblin darkvision and Nimble Escape.
Monster.Booyahg Slave of the Fiend: A goblin warlock of a Fiend patron: use Volo's Warlock of the Fiend stat block, adding goblin darkvision and Nimble Escape.
Monster.Booyahg Slave of the Great Old One: A goblin warlock of a Great Old One patron: use Volo's Warlock of the Great Old One stat block, adding goblin darkvision and Nimble Escape.
Monster.Booyahg Whip: A goblin blessed by its god to boss other goblins around; 1d3 goblins obey it without question. Lore only, no stat block of its own.
Monster.Booyahg Wielder: A goblin that found a magic item (a necklace of fireballs, a circlet of blasting) and learned to use it. Lore only: the item's own rules apply.
Monster.Medusa: The Theros medusa: a serpent-bodied medusa built on the standard medusa, with a Constrict attack (reach 10 feet, 2d6 bludgeoning, grappled and restrained, escape DC 11). Multiattack is snake hair, Constrict and shortsword, or two longbow shots.
Monster.Sergeant: Listed in the book's index at this page. The Forge couldn't confirm a stat block for it; check the page.
Monster.Sphinx of Judgment: An Azorius sphinx: the gynosphinx stat block with a different spell list (friends, mage hand, message; command, ensnaring strike, shield; calm emotions, hold person, suggestion; clairvoyance, counterspell, dispel magic; banishment, divination; dominate person).
Monster.The Bagman: A horror that lurks in the space inside bags of holding and similar containers, snatching whatever reaches in. Full stat block on the page.

Species.Centaur|mot: +2 Strength, +1 Wisdom. Medium fey, 40-foot speed. Hooves (1d4 + Strength bludgeoning), Charge (a bonus-action hoof attack after moving 30 feet straight and hitting in melee), Equine Build (counts as one size larger for carrying; climbing costs extra), and one of Animal Handling, Medicine, Nature or Survival. Common and Sylvan.
Species.Goblin|ggr: +2 Dexterity, +1 Constitution. Small, 30-foot speed, darkvision 60 feet. Fury of the Small adds your level to the damage against a larger creature once per short or long rest, and Nimble Escape lets you Disengage or Hide as a bonus action. Common and Goblin.
Species.Hobgoblin|erlw: +2 Constitution, +1 Intelligence. Medium, 30-foot speed, darkvision 60 feet. Martial Training: light armor and two martial weapons. Saving Face: after missing an attack or failing a check or save, add +1 for each ally you can see within 30 feet (up to +5), once per short or long rest. Common and Goblin.
Species.Minotaur|mot: +2 Strength, +1 Constitution. Medium, 30-foot speed. Horns (1d6 + Strength piercing), Goring Rush (a bonus-action horn attack after Dashing 20 feet), Hammering Horns (a bonus-action shove after a melee hit, Strength save or pushed 10 feet), and Intimidation or Persuasion. Common and Minotaur.
Species.Tiefling (Asmodeus): The usual tiefling (+1 Intelligence beside the tiefling's +2 Charisma, darkvision, fire resistance) with Infernal Legacy: thaumaturgy, then hellish rebuke at 3rd level and darkness at 5th, each once per long rest, cast with Charisma.
Species.Triton|mot: +1 Strength, Constitution and Charisma. Medium, 30-foot walk and swim, breathes air and water, darkvision 60 feet, cold resistance, and talks simply with sea beasts. Control Air and Water: fog cloud, then gust of wind at 3rd level and wall of water at 5th, once per long rest each (Charisma). Common and Primordial.

Other rules.Agonizing Blast: Warlock invocation (needs eldritch blast). Add your Charisma modifier to each eldritch blast hit's damage.
Other rules.Ambush: Battle Master maneuver. Add a superiority die to a Stealth check or an initiative roll, as long as you aren't incapacitated.
Other rules.Arcane Propulsion Armor: Artificer infusion (14th level) for armor. +5 feet of speed; the gauntlets become magic melee weapons (1d8 force, can be thrown 20/60 feet and fly back). The armor can't be taken off against your will and replaces missing limbs.
Other rules.Archery: Fighting style. +2 to attack rolls with ranged weapons.
Other rules.Armor of Magical Strength: Artificer infusion (10th level) for armor. It has 6 charges (1d6 back at dawn): spend one to add your Intelligence modifier to a Strength check or save, or, as a reaction, to avoid being knocked prone.
Other rules.Armor of Shadows: Warlock invocation. Cast mage armor on yourself at will, without a slot or components.
Other rules.Ascendant Step: Warlock invocation (9th level). Cast levitate on yourself at will, without a slot or components.
Other rules.Aspect of the Moon: Warlock invocation (Pact of the Tome). You don't need sleep and magic can't put you to sleep; light activity for 8 hours counts as a long rest.
Other rules.Bait and Switch: Battle Master maneuver. Spend 5 feet of movement to swap places with a willing creature within 5 feet; one of you adds a superiority die to AC until your next turn.
Other rules.Banishing Arrow: Arcane Shot. The target makes a Charisma save or is banished to the Feywild (speed 0, incapacitated) until the end of its next turn. At 18th level the arrow also deals 2d6 force.
Other rules.Beast Speech: Warlock invocation. Cast speak with animals at will, without a slot.
Other rules.Beguiling Arrow: Arcane Shot. +2d6 psychic (4d6 at 18th level), and the target makes a Wisdom save or is charmed by an ally of yours within 30 feet of it until your next turn.
Other rules.Bewitching Whispers: Warlock invocation (7th level). Cast compulsion once per long rest with a warlock spell slot.
Other rules.Blessed Warrior: Paladin fighting style. Learn two cleric cantrips, cast with Charisma.
Other rules.Blind Fighting: Fighting style. Blindsight 10 feet: you see anything nearby that isn't behind total cover, even invisible or in darkness.
Other rules.Bond of the Talisman: Warlock invocation (12th level, Pact of the Talisman). You or the talisman's wearer can teleport next to the other as an action, a number of times per long rest equal to your proficiency bonus.
Other rules.Book of Ancient Secrets: Warlock invocation (Pact of the Tome). Two 1st-level ritual spells from any class go in your Book of Shadows, cast as rituals. You can copy in other rituals you find, as long as their spell level is no higher than half your warlock level (rounded up).
Other rules.Boots of the Winding Path|erlw: Artificer infusion (6th level) for boots, attunement. A bonus action teleports you up to 15 feet back to a space you were in earlier this turn.
Other rules.Boots of the Winding Path|tce: Artificer infusion (6th level) for boots, attunement. A bonus action teleports you up to 15 feet back to a space you were in earlier this turn.
Other rules.Brace: Battle Master maneuver. When a creature you can see moves into your reach, your reaction makes one weapon attack against it, adding a superiority die to the damage.
Other rules.Breath of Winter: Four Elements discipline (17th level). Spend 6 ki to cast cone of cold.
Other rules.Bursting Arrow: Arcane Shot. The arrow explodes: the target and every creature within 10 feet of it take 2d6 force (4d6 at 18th level).
Other rules.Careful Spell: Metamagic (1 sorcery point). Choose up to your Charisma modifier in creatures: they automatically succeed on the spell's save.
Other rules.Chains of Carceri: Warlock invocation (15th level, Pact of the Chain). Cast hold monster at will on a celestial, fiend or elemental, without a slot; each creature only once per long rest.
Other rules.Clench of the North Wind: Four Elements discipline (6th level). Spend 3 ki to cast hold person.
Other rules.Cloak of Flies: Warlock invocation (5th level). A bonus action wraps you in buzzing flies until you're incapacitated or end it: advantage on Intimidation, disadvantage on your other Charisma checks, and creatures starting their turn within 5 feet take poison damage equal to your Charisma modifier. Once per short or long rest.
Other rules.Cloud Rune: Rune Knight rune. Advantage on Sleight of Hand and Deception. Invoke it with your reaction when an attack hits you or a creature you can see within 30 feet: the attack hits another creature of your choice within 30 feet of you instead (not the attacker). Once per short or long rest.
Other rules.Commander's Strike: Battle Master maneuver. Give up one attack and use a bonus action: an ally who can see or hear you uses its reaction to attack, adding your superiority die to the damage.
Other rules.Commanding Presence: Battle Master maneuver. Add a superiority die to an Intimidation, Performance or Persuasion check.
Other rules.Defense: Fighting style. +1 AC while you wear armor.
Other rules.Devil's Sight: Warlock invocation. See normally in darkness, magical or not, out to 120 feet.
Other rules.Disarming Attack: Battle Master maneuver. Add a superiority die to a hit's damage; the target makes a Strength save or drops an item of your choice.
Other rules.Distant Spell: Metamagic (1 sorcery point). Double a spell's range, or give a touch spell a 30-foot range.
Other rules.Distracting Strike: Battle Master maneuver. Add a superiority die to a hit's damage; the next attack on that target by someone else before your next turn has advantage.
Other rules.Dreadful Word: Warlock invocation (7th level). Cast confusion once per long rest with a warlock spell slot.
Other rules.Druidic Warrior: Ranger fighting style. Learn two druid cantrips, cast with Wisdom.
Other rules.Dueling|phb-2014: Fighting style. +2 damage with a melee weapon held in one hand when you hold no other weapon.
Other rules.Dueling|xge: Fighting style. +2 damage with a melee weapon held in one hand when you hold no other weapon.
Other rules.Eldritch Mind: Warlock invocation. Advantage on Constitution saves to keep concentration.
Other rules.Eldritch Sight: Warlock invocation. Cast detect magic at will, without a slot.
Other rules.Eldritch Smite: Warlock invocation (5th level, Pact of the Blade). Once per turn when your pact weapon hits, spend a warlock slot for 1d8 force plus 1d8 per slot level, and knock a Huge or smaller target prone.
Other rules.Eldritch Spear: Warlock invocation (needs eldritch blast). Eldritch blast's range becomes 300 feet.
Other rules.Elemental Attunement: Four Elements discipline (no ki). Small elemental tricks: a harmless sensory effect, light or snuff a small flame, chill or warm a small object, or shape a 1-foot cube of earth, fire, air or water for a minute.
Other rules.Empowered Spell: Metamagic (1 sorcery point). Reroll up to your Charisma modifier in damage dice. Works alongside another Metamagic option.
Other rules.Enfeebling Arrow: Arcane Shot. +2d6 necrotic (4d6 at 18th level), and the target makes a Constitution save or deals only half damage with weapon attacks until your next turn.
Other rules.Enhanced Arcane Focus|erlw: Artificer infusion for a rod, staff or wand, attunement. +1 to spell attack rolls (+2 at 10th level), and your spell attacks ignore half cover.
Other rules.Enhanced Arcane Focus|tce: Artificer infusion for a rod, staff or wand, attunement. +1 to spell attack rolls (+2 at 10th level), and your spell attacks ignore half cover.
Other rules.Enhanced Defense|erlw: Artificer infusion for armor or a shield. +1 AC (+2 at 10th level).
Other rules.Enhanced Defense|tce: Artificer infusion for armor or a shield. +1 AC (+2 at 10th level).
Other rules.Enhanced Weapon|erlw: Artificer infusion for a simple or martial weapon. +1 to attack and damage rolls (+2 at 10th level).
Other rules.Enhanced Weapon|tce: Artificer infusion for a simple or martial weapon. +1 to attack and damage rolls (+2 at 10th level).
Other rules.Eternal Mountain Defense: Four Elements discipline (17th level). Spend 5 ki to cast stoneskin on yourself.
Other rules.Evasive Footwork: Battle Master maneuver. When you move, add a superiority die to your AC until you stop moving.
Other rules.Extended Spell: Metamagic (1 sorcery point). Double a spell's duration of 1 minute or more, up to 24 hours.
Other rules.Eyes of the Rune Keeper: Warlock invocation. You can read all writing.
Other rules.Fangs of the Fire Snake: Four Elements discipline. When you take the Attack action, spend 1 ki: your unarmed strikes reach 10 feet farther this turn and deal fire damage. Spend 1 more ki on a hit for +1d10 fire.
Other rules.Far Scribe: Warlock invocation (5th level, Pact of the Tome). Creatures can write their names in your book (up to your proficiency bonus); you can cast sending to any of them without a slot or materials.
Other rules.Feinting Attack: Battle Master maneuver. A bonus action feints at a creature within 5 feet: advantage on your next attack against it this turn, and add a superiority die to the damage if it hits.
Other rules.Fiendish Vigor: Warlock invocation. Cast false life on yourself at will as a 1st-level spell, without a slot or components.
Other rules.Fire Rune: Rune Knight rune. Double proficiency on tool checks. Invoke it when you hit with a weapon: +2d6 fire, and a Strength save or the target is restrained and burns for 2d6 each turn (save again each turn; up to 1 minute). Once per short or long rest.
Other rules.Fist of Four Thunders: Four Elements discipline. Spend 2 ki to cast thunderwave.
Other rules.Flames of the Phoenix: Four Elements discipline (11th level). Spend 4 ki to cast fireball.
Other rules.Frost Rune: Rune Knight rune. Advantage on Animal Handling and Intimidation. Invoke it as a bonus action: +2 to Strength and Constitution checks and saves for 10 minutes. Once per short or long rest.
Other rules.Gaze of Two Minds: Warlock invocation. Touch a willing humanoid to see and hear through its senses until the end of your next turn (renew it with an action each turn); meanwhile you're blind and deaf to your own surroundings.
Other rules.Ghostly Gaze: Warlock invocation (7th level). An action lets you see through solid objects within 30 feet for up to a minute (concentration). Once per short or long rest.
Other rules.Gift of the Depths: Warlock invocation (5th level). Breathe underwater, swim at your walking speed, and cast water breathing once per long rest without a slot.
Other rules.Gift of the Ever-Living Ones: Warlock invocation (Pact of the Chain). While your familiar is within 100 feet, healing dice you roll for yourself count as their maximum.
Other rules.Gift of the Protectors: Warlock invocation (9th level, Pact of the Tome). Creatures can write their names in your book (up to your proficiency bonus). When one of them drops to 0 hit points without being killed outright, it drops to 1 instead, once per long rest.
Other rules.Goading Attack: Battle Master maneuver. Add a superiority die to a hit's damage; the target makes a Wisdom save or has disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until your next turn ends.
Other rules.Gong of the Summit: Four Elements discipline (6th level). Spend 3 ki to cast shatter.
Other rules.Grappling Strike: Battle Master maneuver. Right after a melee hit, a bonus action tries to grapple the target, adding a superiority die to your Athletics check.
Other rules.Grasp of Hadar: Warlock invocation (needs eldritch blast). Once per turn, an eldritch blast hit can pull the creature up to 10 feet straight toward you.
Other rules.Grasping Arrow: Arcane Shot. +2d6 poison, and brambles wrap the target for 1 minute: -10 feet of speed and 2d6 slashing the first time each turn it moves (4d6 each at 18th level). An Athletics check against your Arcane Shot DC pulls it off.
Other rules.Great Weapon Fighting: Fighting style. Reroll 1s and 2s on the damage dice of a two-handed or versatile melee weapon held in two hands (keep the new roll).
Other rules.Heightened Spell: Metamagic (3 sorcery points). One target of the spell has disadvantage on its first save against it.
Other rules.Helm of Awareness: Artificer infusion (10th level) for a helmet, attunement. Advantage on initiative, and you can't be surprised unless you're incapacitated.
Other rules.Hill Rune: Rune Knight rune (7th level). Advantage on saves against being poisoned and resistance to poison. Invoke it as a bonus action: resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing for 1 minute. Once per short or long rest.
Other rules.Homunculus Servant|erlw: Artificer infusion: a 100 gp gem becomes a Tiny homunculus that obeys you. AC 13, hit points 1 + Intelligence modifier + artificer level, flies 30 feet, Force Strike (1d4 + proficiency force), Evasion, and it can deliver your touch spells. It Dodges unless you command it with a bonus action.
Other rules.Homunculus Servant|tce: Artificer infusion: a 100 gp gem becomes a Tiny homunculus that obeys you. AC 13, hit points 1 + Intelligence modifier + artificer level, flies 30 feet, a ranged Force Strike (1d4 + proficiency force), Evasion, and it can deliver your touch spells. It Dodges unless you command it with a bonus action.
Other rules.Improved Pact Weapon: Warlock invocation (Pact of the Blade). Your pact weapon is a spellcasting focus and gets +1 to hit and damage unless it already has a bonus; it can also be a shortbow, longbow or crossbow.
Other rules.Interception: Fighting style. With a shield or a simple or martial weapon in hand, your reaction cuts the damage to a creature within 5 feet of you by 1d10 + your proficiency bonus.
Other rules.Investment of the Chain Master: Warlock invocation (Pact of the Chain). Your familiar gains a 40-foot fly or swim speed, attacks when you command it with a bonus action, its weapon attacks count as magical, it uses your spell save DC, and your reaction can give it resistance to damage.
Other rules.Lance of Lethargy: Warlock invocation (needs eldritch blast). Once per turn, an eldritch blast hit can cut the creature's speed by 10 feet until your next turn ends.
Other rules.Lifedrinker: Warlock invocation (12th level, Pact of the Blade). Your pact weapon hits deal extra necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).
Other rules.Lunging Attack: Battle Master maneuver. One melee attack gets 5 more feet of reach; add a superiority die to its damage if it hits.
Other rules.Maddening Hex: Warlock invocation (5th level, needs hex or a warlock curse). A bonus action deals psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier to your cursed target within 30 feet and to creatures of your choice within 5 feet of it.
Other rules.Maneuvering Attack: Battle Master maneuver. Add a superiority die to a hit's damage; an ally can use its reaction to move half its speed without provoking an opportunity attack from the target.
Other rules.Mask of Many Faces: Warlock invocation. Cast disguise self at will, without a slot.
Other rules.Master of Myriad Forms: Warlock invocation (15th level). Cast alter self at will, without a slot.
Other rules.Menacing Attack: Battle Master maneuver. Add a superiority die to a hit's damage; the target makes a Wisdom save or is frightened of you until your next turn ends.
Other rules.Mind Sharpener: Artificer infusion for armor or robes, attunement. 4 charges (1d4 back at dawn): when you fail a concentration save, your reaction spends one to succeed instead.
Other rules.Minions of Chaos: Warlock invocation (9th level). Cast conjure elemental once per long rest with a warlock spell slot.
Other rules.Mire the Mind: Warlock invocation (5th level). Cast slow once per long rest with a warlock spell slot.
Other rules.Mist Stance: Four Elements discipline (11th level). Spend 4 ki to cast gaseous form on yourself.
Other rules.Misty Visions: Warlock invocation. Cast silent image at will, without a slot or components.
Other rules.One with Shadows: Warlock invocation (5th level). In dim light or darkness, an action makes you invisible until you move or take an action or reaction.
Other rules.Otherworldly Leap: Warlock invocation (9th level). Cast jump on yourself at will, without a slot or components.
Other rules.Pact of the Blade: Warlock pact boon. An action summons your pact weapon in any melee form; you're proficient with it and it counts as magical. You can also bind a magic weapon to you in a 1-hour ritual.
Other rules.Pact of the Chain: Warlock pact boon. Learn find familiar as a ritual; your familiar can also be an imp, pseudodragon, quasit or sprite. Give up one of your attacks to let it attack with its reaction.
Other rules.Pact of the Talisman: Warlock pact boon. Your amulet lets its wearer add a d4 to a failed ability check, a number of times per long rest equal to your proficiency bonus.
Other rules.Pact of the Tome: Warlock pact boon. Your Book of Shadows holds three cantrips from any class's list, cast at will while it's with you.
Other rules.Parry: Battle Master maneuver. When a melee attack hits you, your reaction reduces the damage by a superiority die + your Dexterity modifier.
Other rules.Piercing Arrow: Arcane Shot. No attack roll: the arrow flies through a 30-foot line. Each creature in it makes a Dexterity save, taking the arrow's damage + 1d6 piercing (2d6 at 18th level) on a failure, half on a success.
Other rules.Precision Attack: Battle Master maneuver. Add a superiority die to an attack roll, before or after rolling but before you know the result.
Other rules.Protection: Fighting style. With a shield, your reaction gives disadvantage to an attack against a creature within 5 feet of you.
Other rules.Protection of the Talisman: Warlock invocation (7th level, Pact of the Talisman). The talisman's wearer adds a d4 to a failed save, a number of times per long rest equal to your proficiency bonus.
Other rules.Pushing Attack: Battle Master maneuver. Add a superiority die to a hit's damage; a Large or smaller target makes a Strength save or is pushed 15 feet away.
Other rules.Quick Toss: Battle Master maneuver. A bonus action throws a thrown weapon (drawing it as part of the throw), adding a superiority die to the damage.
Other rules.Quickened Spell: Metamagic (2 sorcery points). Cast a 1-action spell as a bonus action.
Other rules.Radiant Weapon|erlw: Artificer infusion (6th level) for a simple or martial weapon, attunement. +1 to attack and damage, sheds light on command, and 4 charges (1d4 back at dawn): when you're hit, your reaction spends one to make the attacker save (Constitution) or be blinded until its next turn ends.
Other rules.Radiant Weapon|tce: Artificer infusion (6th level) for a simple or martial weapon, attunement. +1 to attack and damage, sheds light on command, and 4 charges (1d4 back at dawn): when you're hit, your reaction spends one to make the attacker save (Constitution) or be blinded until its next turn ends.
Other rules.Rally: Battle Master maneuver. A bonus action gives an ally who can see or hear you temporary hit points equal to a superiority die + your Charisma modifier.
Other rules.Rebuke of the Talisman: Warlock invocation (Pact of the Talisman). When the wearer is hit by a creature you can see within 30 feet, your reaction deals psychic damage equal to your proficiency bonus to it and pushes it 10 feet away.
Other rules.Relentless Hex: Warlock invocation (7th level, needs hex or a warlock curse). A bonus action teleports you up to 30 feet to a space within 5 feet of your cursed target.
Other rules.Repeating Shot|erlw: Artificer infusion for a weapon with the ammunition property, attunement. +1 to attack and damage, ignores loading, and makes its own magic ammunition when fired empty.
Other rules.Repeating Shot|tce: Artificer infusion for a weapon with the ammunition property, attunement. +1 to attack and damage, ignores loading, and makes its own magic ammunition when fired empty.
Other rules.Repelling Blast: Warlock invocation (needs eldritch blast). Each eldritch blast hit can push the creature up to 10 feet away.
Other rules.Replicate Magic Item|erlw: Artificer infusion: make a magic item from the book's lists for your level (or any common item except potions and scrolls). Can be learned again for a different item; the item's own rules apply.
Other rules.Replicate Magic Item|tce: Artificer infusion: make a magic item from the book's lists for your level (or any common item except potions and scrolls). Can be learned again for a different item; the item's own rules apply.
Other rules.Repulsion Shield|erlw: Artificer infusion (6th level) for a shield, attunement. +1 AC and 4 charges (1d4 back at dawn): when a melee attack hits you, your reaction spends one to push the attacker 15 feet away.
Other rules.Repulsion Shield|tce: Artificer infusion (6th level) for a shield, attunement. +1 AC and 4 charges (1d4 back at dawn): when a melee attack hits you, your reaction spends one to push the attacker 15 feet away.
Other rules.Resistant Armor|erlw: Artificer infusion (6th level) for armor, attunement. Its wearer resists one damage type you choose (acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, poison, psychic, radiant or thunder).
Other rules.Resistant Armor|tce: Artificer infusion (6th level) for armor, attunement. Its wearer resists one damage type you choose (acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, poison, psychic, radiant or thunder).
Other rules.Returning Weapon|erlw: Artificer infusion for a thrown weapon. +1 to attack and damage, and it flies back to your hand after a ranged attack.
Other rules.Returning Weapon|tce: Artificer infusion for a thrown weapon. +1 to attack and damage, and it flies back to your hand after a ranged attack.
Other rules.Ride the Wind: Four Elements discipline (11th level). Spend 4 ki to cast fly on yourself.
Other rules.Riposte: Battle Master maneuver. When a creature misses you in melee, your reaction makes a melee attack against it, adding a superiority die to the damage.
Other rules.River of Hungry Flame: Four Elements discipline (17th level). Spend 5 ki to cast wall of fire.
Other rules.Rush of the Gale Spirits: Four Elements discipline. Spend 2 ki to cast gust of wind.
Other rules.Sculptor of Flesh: Warlock invocation (7th level). Cast polymorph once per long rest with a warlock spell slot.
Other rules.Seeking Arrow: Arcane Shot. No attack roll: name a creature you've seen recently; the arrow curves around cover to find it. Dexterity save: arrow damage + 1d6 force (2d6 at 18th level) and you learn where it is, or half damage on a success.
Other rules.Seeking Spell: Metamagic (2 sorcery points). Reroll a missed spell attack roll.
Other rules.Shadow Arrow: Arcane Shot. +2d6 psychic (4d6 at 18th level), and the target makes a Wisdom save or can't see beyond 5 feet until your next turn.
Other rules.Shape the Flowing River: Four Elements discipline. Spend 1 ki to reshape water and ice in a 30-foot cube within 120 feet: raise or lower it, freeze or thaw it, or carve trenches and walls.
Other rules.Shroud of Shadow: Warlock invocation (15th level). Cast invisibility at will, without a slot.
Other rules.Sign of Ill Omen: Warlock invocation (5th level). Cast bestow curse once per long rest with a warlock spell slot.
Other rules.Spell-Refueling Ring: Artificer infusion (6th level) for a ring, attunement. Once per dawn, an action recovers one spent spell slot of 3rd level or lower.
Other rules.Stone Rune: Rune Knight rune. Advantage on Insight and darkvision 120 feet. Invoke it with your reaction when a creature within 30 feet ends its turn: Wisdom save or it's charmed, incapacitated and has speed 0 for up to a minute (save again each turn). Once per short or long rest.
Other rules.Storm Rune: Rune Knight rune (7th level). Advantage on Arcana and you can't be surprised. Invoke it as a bonus action: for 1 minute your reaction can give advantage or disadvantage on a roll by a creature you can see within 60 feet. Once per short or long rest.
Other rules.Subtle Spell: Metamagic (1 sorcery point). Cast without verbal or somatic components.
Other rules.Superior Technique: Fighting style. Learn one Battle Master maneuver and gain one d6 superiority die, back on a short or long rest.
Other rules.Sweeping Attack: Battle Master maneuver. After a melee hit, another creature within 5 feet of the target (and within your reach) takes the superiority die as damage, if your attack roll would hit it.
Other rules.Sweeping Cinder Strike: Four Elements discipline. Spend 2 ki to cast burning hands.
Other rules.Tactical Assessment: Battle Master maneuver. Add a superiority die to an Investigation, History or Insight check.
Other rules.Thief of Five Fates: Warlock invocation. Cast bane once per long rest with a warlock spell slot.
Other rules.Thirsting Blade: Warlock invocation (5th level, Pact of the Blade). Attack twice with your pact weapon when you take the Attack action.
Other rules.Thrown Weapon Fighting: Fighting style. Draw a thrown weapon as part of the attack, and +2 damage when you hit with one as a ranged attack.
Other rules.Tomb of Levistus: Warlock invocation (5th level). When you take damage, your reaction encases you in ice: 10 temporary hit points per warlock level against that damage, but until your next turn ends you have speed 0, are incapacitated and are vulnerable to fire. Once per short or long rest.
Other rules.Transmuted Spell: Metamagic (1 sorcery point). Change a spell's acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison or thunder damage to another of those types.
Other rules.Trickster's Escape: Warlock invocation (7th level). Cast freedom of movement on yourself once per long rest without a slot.
Other rules.Trip Attack: Battle Master maneuver. Add a superiority die to a hit's damage; a Large or smaller target makes a Strength save or falls prone.
Other rules.Twinned Spell: Metamagic (sorcery points equal to the spell's level, 1 for a cantrip). A spell that targets one creature and can't target more also targets a second creature in range.
Other rules.Two-Weapon Fighting|phb-2014: Fighting style. Add your ability modifier to the damage of your off-hand attack.
Other rules.Two-Weapon Fighting|xge: Fighting style. Add your ability modifier to the damage of your off-hand attack.
Other rules.Unarmed Fighting: Fighting style. Unarmed strikes deal 1d6 + Strength (1d8 with both hands free of weapons and shields), and a creature you're grappling takes 1d4 bludgeoning at the start of each of your turns.
Other rules.Unbroken Air: Four Elements discipline (Fist of Unbroken Air). Spend 2 ki: a creature within 30 feet makes a Strength save or takes 3d10 bludgeoning (+1d10 per extra ki), is pushed 20 feet and knocked prone; half damage only on a success.
Other rules.Undying Servitude: Warlock invocation (5th level). Cast animate dead once per long rest without a slot.
Other rules.Visions of Distant Realms: Warlock invocation (15th level). Cast arcane eye at will, without a slot.
Other rules.Voice of the Chain Master: Warlock invocation (Pact of the Chain). Talk telepathically with your familiar and see and hear through it at any distance on the same plane, and speak in your voice through it.
Other rules.Water Whip: Four Elements discipline. Spend 2 ki: a creature within 30 feet makes a Dexterity save or takes 3d10 bludgeoning (+1d10 per extra ki) and is pulled 25 feet closer or knocked prone; half damage only on a success.
Other rules.Wave of Rolling Earth: Four Elements discipline (17th level). Spend 6 ki to cast wall of stone.
Other rules.Whispers of the Grave: Warlock invocation (9th level). Cast speak with dead at will, without a slot.
Other rules.Witch Sight: Warlock invocation (15th level). See the true form of shapechangers and of creatures hidden by illusion or transformation magic within 30 feet.
